geonames.role: Canonical administrative hierarchy, boundary and coordinates

wikivoyage.role: Curated tourist sights, structured opening hours, and travel listing metadata

wikidata.role: Spatial travel destination discovery and verified entity claims

openstreetmap.role: Local travel tags, opening hours, contact details, and coordinates

overture.role: Broad commercial venues, discovery venues, and validation

wikimedia_commons.license: Per-file open licenses (CC-BY, CC-BY-SA, CC0, Public Domain)
wikimedia_commons.attribution: Individual photographers as recorded in image_manifest.json

license_isolation_policy: Factual non-copyrightable data merged into canonical permissive dataset. Wikivoyage prose and Commons imagery maintain exact author attribution and license provenance.
